name: ai-robot-operator
description: AI Robot Operator - ระบบควบคุมเครื่องจักรด้วย AI

scripts.dev: concurrently --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,magenta" --names "OLLAMA,BACKEND,FRONTEND" --kill-others-on-fail false "npm run ollama" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && echo Setup complete!
